history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: the CSV's generic 'Durga Temple' has no single definitive referent — Raigarh city has several Durga shrines (Vinoba Nagar/Sangitarai, Mitthumuda, Surya Vihar Colony). This file documents Maa Durga Mandir, Surya Vihar Colony, Raigarh (map listing ~21.898269, 83.392079), the best-documented of them: a local Devi shrine about 1.7 km from Raigarh railway station, rated 3.9/5, with visitor reviews describing crowds during Durga Puja and Maha Shivratri. No founding history, dynasty, or construction date is documented anywhere for this shrine; it appears to be a modern local temple. Coordinates are the map-listing point, treated as approximate. If the CSV intended a different Raigarh Durga shrine (e.g. Mitthumuda Durga Mandir), this row needs re-mapping.

town_description: Raigarh is a city and district headquarters in Chhattisgarh on the Kelo river, a major steel and power industrial hub. It is also known for the Chandrahasini Devi temple at Chandrapur nearby and for the Raigarh gharana of classical music.
